Definition: Elihu, the name of one of Job's friends, and of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elihu is the name of one of Job's friends, and of three Israelites. In 1 Samuel 1:1, the text says "the son of Elihu." The life behind the name is told on the Elihu People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elihu matters because God knows His people by name, and Elihu is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
